title: The Auto Shankar Murders
evidence: Police investigation connected Shankar and his associates to multiple disappearances
Victims' remains were recovered after the investigation
The trial resulted in murder convictions and death sentences
His accomplices were also convicted in connection with the murders
modus_operandi: Shankar operated within a criminal network involved in illicit liquor and prostitution. He used associates and his criminal influence to lure, abduct, and murder victims, subsequently concealing or destroying their remains.
personality_disorder: No reliably documented formal personality-disorder diagnosis should be assigned. His documented behavioral profile includes manipulation, coercive control, violence, criminal opportunism, and exploitation of people within his criminal network.
summary: Gowri Shankar, popularly known as Auto Shankar, was a Tamil Nadu criminal involved in multiple murders, kidnappings, and organized criminal activity. He was convicted of six murders and executed in 1995.
